Response b suffers from a clearer logical breakdown: it jumps between unrelated statistics, dumping practices, material categories, export figures, and health effects without transitional framing, showing an Unclear Flow/Jumping issue in addition to structural problems and redundancy. The abrupt topic shifts make its overall argument harder to follow, so response a is superior in logical coherence.

coherence_stylistic.explantion: Both responses are reported to have a consistent formal academic tone, uniform technical vocabulary, and a steady third‑person perspective; no stylistic inconsistencies were found in either critique.
